what_it_does: One 97 Communications Ltd operates an AI-powered omni-channel payment platform and digital financial services ecosystem for consumers and merchants in India. It provides merchant payment acceptance solutions, loan and insurance distribution, equity broking, and marketing services.

segments.name: Payment Services
segments.comment: Includes payment processing, soundbox and POS subscriptions, and other operating revenue.

segments.name: Distribution of Financial Services
segments.comment: Fastest-growing high-margin segment driven primarily by merchant and consumer loan distribution.

segments.name: Marketing Services
segments.comment: Includes advertising, travel ticketing, credit card distribution, and deals and gift vouchers.

scale: Over 4.5 crore merchants joined the digital economy through zero-cost QR solutions.
Subscription merchant base crossed 1.51 crore as of March 2026.
Average monthly transacting users expanded to 7.7 crore by Q4 FY26.
Average of 47,826 active on-roll employees in FY 2026.
risks: Adverse macro-economic conditions affecting customers and merchants.
Failure to maintain best-in-class technology infrastructure amid rapid innovation.
Vulnerability of data and technology infrastructures to cyber attacks.
Fast-evolving regulatory landscape impacting compliance requirements.
geography: Primarily domestic in India, with international expansion underway in select markets such as UAE, Singapore, and Indonesia.
